users.title: User Profile
users.description: Stores user profile information like display name and avatar URL.

uid.description: The unique identifier for the user (Firebase Auth UID).

photoURL.description: The URL to the user's avatar image.

updatedAt.description: The timestamp of the last profile update.

api_keys.title: API Key
api_keys.description: Stores a user's generated API key and its metadata.

uid.description: The unique identifier for the user (Firebase Auth UID).

lastGeneratedAt.description: The timestamp of the last key generation.

/users/{userId}.description: A collection of user profile documents, keyed by their Auth UID.

/api_keys/{userId}.description: A collection of API keys, keyed by the user's Auth UID.
